title: The Azure Fold Discipline
summary: The school discipline of folding the sky-bright reach of space round the user and letting it fall on the foe in a single convergence.

title: The Zenith Reach Manual
summary: The school manual of reaching to the highest point of a blow's arc and bringing it down upon the foe from there.

title: Canon of the Apogee
summary: The school canon of sending force to the farthest point of its course and having it return as a single ascendant stroke.

title: The Boundless Dominion Treatise
summary: The school's high treatise on a space without limit about the user in which the user alone may move freely.

title: The Breach Storm Discipline
summary: The school discipline of breaching the space between two bodies again and again until the breaches rise into a storm.

title: Manual of the Tilted World
summary: The school manual of tilting the ground and the air at once so the foe loses every sense of up and level.

title: Canon of the Hollow Crown
summary: The school canon of hollowing a ring of space about the foe's head and closing it in a crown.

title: The Seamless Whole Treatise
summary: The school's deepest treatise on joining every near and far point into one seamless whole that the user commands.
